content:
Recurring Purchase Invoice

Create purchase invoices that repeat on a regular schedule.

Useful for rent, subscriptions, and other regular supplier bills.

Next issue date

The date when the next purchase invoice will be automatically created. This date advances automatically based on your frequency settings.

Set this to match when you expect to receive the supplier's invoice. The system checks daily for invoices due to be created.

Due date

The number of days after the issue date when payment is due. This sets the due date for each generated invoice.

This should match your supplier's payment terms. For example, enter 30 for Net 30 terms, or 14 for payment due in two weeks.

Interval

The frequency interval for creating invoices. This number works with the period type to match your supplier's billing cycle.

Common examples: 1 Month = monthly bills, 3 Months = quarterly payments, 1 Year = annual contracts, 2 Weeks = fortnightly services.

PeriodType

The period type that works with the interval to determine frequency. Select the unit of time for your supplier's billing cycle.

Most suppliers bill monthly, but adjust this to match your actual billing schedule.

MonthDay

For monthly recurring invoices, specify which day of the month the invoice should be created.

Match this to when your supplier typically issues invoices. For example, rent due on the 1st, utilities on the 15th.

ExpirationType

Determines when the recurring schedule ends. This controls how long the system will continue creating purchase invoices.

Choose 'Until further notice' for ongoing expenses like utilities, or 'Until date' for fixed-term contracts.

UntilDate

The date when recurring invoices will stop being created. The system will not create any invoices after this date.

Use this for leases, fixed-term service contracts, or any expense with a known end date.

Supplier

Select the supplier who bills you regularly. Each generated purchase invoice will be linked to this supplier.

The supplier's payment terms and other settings will be applied to each new invoice.

Description

A description that identifies what you're being billed for. This appears on each generated purchase invoice.

Be descriptive to help with expense tracking. Examples: 'Monthly Office Rent', 'Quarterly Software License', 'Weekly Cleaning Service'.

Lines

The invoice lines specifying what you're being charged for. These exact lines will appear on every generated purchase invoice.

Set up lines for each expense category. Use the appropriate expense accounts for proper financial reporting.

If prices are subject to change, you'll need to edit this template when your supplier adjusts their rates.

Automatic reference

When enabled, the system automatically assigns reference numbers to each generated purchase invoice.

You might disable this if you want to manually enter your supplier's invoice numbers when you receive them.
